summary: Add closed read-only service admission for receipt/state claims and typed work items; service document namespaces and production issuance remain disabled

replay.detail: No migration; grant storage and digest authentication retain their existing meanings.

schema.detail: No fractal-schema or device pairing changes.

rules.detail: Service bearers on both routers require a registered GET/read-scope pair. Claim bodies use a closed gate-result/work-state field schema excluding literal gate names. All other kinds expose only store_index and a fixed withheld marker in unfiltered pages and return not-found by id. Service selectors match only allowlisted claim kinds, restricted in SQL before paging; filtered pages never contain withheld markers or indexes. Work reads use a separate typed identifier/state/clock DTO excluding person answers, summaries and all other free-text subviews, without acknowledging wakes. Document scope and routes remain registered but every service document read is refused because the namespace allowlist is empty. Unknown routes, upgrades and mutations are refused before dispatch. Daemon-owned read-window audits are bounded per grant.

compatibility.detail: New client claim/work aliases are service-only; existing non-service native reads retain their semantics. Browser ingress refuses mixed admitted-cookie/Authorization requests instead of discarding the bearer. Assistant scopes and disclosure consent are unchanged. Service issuance remains disabled; owner lifecycle and rollout safety remain prerequisites.

downtime.detail: No downtime is required for this change.

manual.detail: No manual step is required; production service issuance remains disabled.

recovery.detail: No recovery action is needed; this change introduces no migration or persisted-state conversion.
